review_description: The team of 5 installed the 10.9kW solar system with a 32kWh battery from Sigenergy, and they were on time, professional, and friendly.There had been a minor paperwork issue; however, they took initiative and rectified it on the spot, and I was very impressed!I referred one of my friends to go with them, who did the installation this week, and I heard the same, despite the different team from different areas in Melbourne.I would highly recommend Winky to anyone who wants a professional and patient installer who knows what they are doing.Now the next step is to wait for the final inspection before the system can be switched on.I am more than happy to post a follow-up comment 6~12 months down the line.
Everyone at Winki have been great just waiting  for  inspection
Such a straight forward process. Thank you WINKI. I feel like I'm future proofed.
Winki provided the full home backup solution I was after with quality products. The sales team and install team worked seamlessly and the system is working as expected

Couldn’t rate the team any higher! From 1st meeting with David to the end of the process, the whole team were very professional, fast and extremely customer oriented. Would recommend the team to everybody
Process was very easy and all staff were very helpful

Sales/quoting process : Polite, informative, patient, detailed yet understandableInstallation : Polite, Neat and Tidy, Punctual and Quiet.Fully briefed on the inverter, the app and the grid connection process

From the beginning with David coming to our home sitting down with us and listening to our questions, analysing our current power bill and then sending through quotes, we knew we were in good hands. There was never any upselling. Just honest recommendations.Whole process was quick and easy which surprised us the most. Should have done it sooner is our only regret. Great job Winki!

Winki solar were recommended by Geelong sustainability and their response during the design and equipment option evaluation was quick and responsive. They were quick to proceed to purchase and installation and both the roofers and Sparkies were very professional and did a great job. Following installation their support team continued their really excellent service.

Process was all easy. Dex visited and did a site inspection. Flew the drone over and shared some of the photos. Adjusted the panel layout accordingly. Install team were all very professional. No complaints.

I have no way of comparing this to other installers, so cannot really rate them fairly. They did the job that they were contracted to do. I have no way of  knowing if they did a good or bad job.  The system works as I would expect.

The sales and quoting process was great with several well laid out proposals to choose from. We were very happy with the photos, layout and information in the final proposal which assisted us with gaining council planning and owners corporation permissions for installation.The installation was very efficient. The team was very friendly and tidied up after themselves well.This is the third time we’ve installed solar on a home and this is by far the best experience we’ve had. We are so grateful to have found a company we feel we can trust.

And just like that, my home is now solar powered. The project went very smooth and worry-free. I trusted Winki with this investment, and they delivered impressively!The installation team was great! The workmanship was very clean. They persevered through the heat to get it done, safely.Dex was fantastic, 10/10 for customer care and engagement. Very diligent with all my questions and requests.Well done, Winki Team!

From sales and quoting, install, and after sales support, Winki Solar were fantastic. We are extremely happy with our new install that replaced our old solar system. The whole process from start to end, including organising the grid connection update with our electricity provider was seamless. Their knowledge of renewable energy, professionalism and customer service was just amazing. We were extremely happy with Winki Solar and would highly recommend them.

The sales process and quoting process was given in great detail. The information was clear and concise which made things easier to understand.The turnaround time from getting the quote, applying for the rebate and actually getting the system installed was extremely quick. The Winki Solar crew were fantastic, very approachable and answered any questions we had with good knowledge. The cleaned everything up upon completion of the install.Heath sat down and explained to us the following procedures involved after the install and organised an inspector to come out and get the system signed off.The entire process was very easy from beginning to end which is why we would recommend Winki Solar to friends and family thinking about getting solar.

Winki Solar provided a very professional and efficient install on our solar battery system, integrating our existing solar panels.   Great pre and after sales support regarding our old system and assistance with our electricity provider.  Very happy and would recommend Winki Solar.

My experience with Winki Solar could not have been any more efficient and professional that what it was. The team at Winki Solar handled the installation to the grid and any other set up requirementsI would recommend Winki Solar to anyone that' wants a no fuss straight forward installation.

Winki did a great job with installing our solar system. They were right on time and very professional. Great communication and manners. The system is up and running now and there is always someone at Winki to answer your questions or concerns. That what you would expect from your installer that after market care. Thank you Winki!

We have just had our system installed and inspected and couldn’t be happier with the process and results. Steve and his team demonstrated how knowledgeable they were at every step of the process from initial planning to handover. Dex held our hand all the way through and made sure we were up to date with everything that was being done. The team were punctual and respectful of our property during the install and showed professionalism through their use of proper safety systems and keeping the site clean and tidy.A great experience that I can recommend to anyone. Thanks Winki Solar!

Dex was incredibly helpful (and patient) in explaining the various options and quotes, plus what would suit my needs best. He was really detailed and thorough.The quote acceptance and booking procedure was easy and all information readily communicated.The installation crew were friendly, professional and tidy - they did a great job.I'm really happy with my decision to use a local supplier, and I'd absolutely recommend Winki to anyone wanting to install Solar - they're great!
Waiting  for the final inspection,  installation  on such a windy day they were very professional with safety, quality with installation,  and explained  details of operation on completion.

Very pleased with Winki Solar. Had an unknown problem and after examining my solar system they found numerous faults from when it was installed years ago. Received a full page report on what was done so I was not in the dark. Highly recommend Winki as a trust worthy installer and after sales trade person.
Great professional service & installation work. Advised me for the best system required for my house. Thank you so much Winki Team.Would definitely recommend Winki Solar.
Winki were fantastic to deal with from the initial quote, to arranging installation, and managing all the admin to arrange rebates, certification and connection.  Highly recommended.

Time was taken in the sales and quoting process to determine the appropriate system and requirements.the Installation was of the highest quality, prompt and professional service with an aesthetically pleasing result, attention was paid to the reduction of wind damage and corrosion effects.the connection was seamless both to the software and the grid.assisted through the activation and installation of the system.
Super flexible and patient with explaining options, costs, benefits etc - so simple to deal with and a great bunch of humans!

Winki Solar were very professional and explained all of the steps to my wife and I and how the whole thing works . Was a 2 day install and the guys were very respectful and tidy. The sales consultant was always contactable if we had a question, and he was a big part of our decision to go with Winki. I love looking at my phone now to see how much electricity I am producing.Thank you Winki, well done.

My first contact was with the lovely Andrew - a tradie himself he is more than a salesperson. He knows the product and the industry well and provided a lot of good information and examples. He was also the first person who suggested the panels should be installed flat and took the time to explain the reasons. The Winki tech team are also fab. A site inspection threw up a tricky issue which was resolved by their electrician. The installation itself was great with another tricky curve ball resolved by the head electrician’s ingenuity. The team were professional and easy to have around keeping me informed along the way. The Winki back office are also fab, professional and responsive. Very happy.

From the get go Winki was great.Andrew contacted me to discuss what we needed, after hearing our previous tale of woe about having trying to get solar installed he walked me thru the steps and the time line.We originally were looking at a 6.6kW system but after some back and forth we decided to go with a larger 8.3kW system. The old saying you'll never regret going for a larger system was the driving force. We tend to be really heavy day time users during winter and summer and above average in spring / autumn.Andrew and the guys made it really easy to under stand and I thought the out of pocked price was more than reasonable.We also had follow up regarding the quotes making sure we understood it and seeing where we were at.The solar system was installed over 2 days. 18 & 19 Dec 2023. Richard the lead installer was great. Turned up on time gave us a heads up when they needed to turn off the power and then showed me the ins and outs of the user app etc.Also very impressed that the guys didn't leave behind any scraps or rubbish, on the ground you'd be hard pressed to see that any one was even here.Looking forward now to having it switched on and saving money.Over all 100 % would recommend winki
We were treated with professionalism and courtesy. The team were punctual and tidy. We are now waiting for inspection.

Winki Solar did a great job installing our system. They were efficent, friendly and left everything in great condition. The isntallation even went ahead before the scheduled date. Can't recommend them enough.

Dealing with something you are weary of doing can be hard.But Winky Solar was a breath of fresh air.They explained the whole process very well and did not try to push me in choosing a system I did not need.

Went with Winki Solar following a recommendation from a friend who works in the industry. Very glad we did - Winki gave us a proposal that was tailored to our needs, and they were more than happy to talk through the details. Other companies I spoke to were not as keen to explain their recommendations.Staff were all super responsive throughout the sign up and application process and they went out of their way to make install work around our schedule.Install itself was efficient and completed with a high attention to detail. The crew explained what they were doing at different stages and our roof was left in immaculate condition.Couldn’t be happier with the final result - looks super neat and tidy and, most importantly, has all been working efficiently since the day it was commissioned. Thank you Winki!
Sales & quoting Service professional helpful & friendly.Installation Team again professional, efficient & friendly blokesWinki Solar a pleasure to deal with.

We completed a full renovation on our house in Brunswick. Winki were selected as our Solar and battery installer due to a recommendation from a friend. We found them professional to deal with and they were happy to work around the building team. We got 13kw Solar and 2 Tesla Powerwall batteries. We have had zero bills since it was installed and thats been through winter. We had some professional photos done of our house and the solar looks great
Very neat job, can hardly see the wires from switch to unit- very quick turnaround from call- very happy!

The entire process was simple, affordable and exceptional.I couldn’t have my solar installed when I first reached out because of neighbouring trees, so I sat tight for more than 6 months and let Winki know. Not only was I remembered but I was contacted immediately and everything was explained to me simply and easily.All I had to do was the paperwork. The quote process was easy and electronic and I found the price for our set up reasonable and competitive.The install was done in a day and a bit and the lads were professional and communicative.I’m so impressed with everything. The service is top notch.
Winki Solar were great to work with. Responded to all my emails promptly and were professional during the installation process.
I couldn’t be happier with Winki Solar, they did a great job from initial contact through to install and follow up service. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to friends.
Very happy with the final product. Friendly helpful staff. Checked in with me at all phases of the job where decisions had to be made and clarified any and all questions I had. System running well.

My experience with Winki Solar has been first class.  From the initial contact with Andrew, the follow-through with Dexter, the interaction with the installation team Jack, Damian, Michael, and   also Michael in accounts, every aspect of the process has been handled in an extremely professional manner,  I have been impressed by Winki's processes and their high level of communication.  I was also pleasantly surprised by how quickly they delivered the final product.  Less than a month from my initial contact to completion, and it could have been quicker had I not had a minor delay from my end.  A job well done team Winki!
Excellent communication between sales with a range of product options provided.Punctual and tidy installation.

Outstanding customer service and support throughout the installation process and beyond. The Winki people are a friendly, polite, hard-working team. I'm very grateful for their professionalism and dedication to solar energy.
We were really happy with our selection of Winki to install our system in Geelong.   The quoting process & installation all went smoothly and the team were great at keeping us informed of progress.

The quoting/sales process was good, the sales guy was pretty knowledgeable and happy to chat through my options over the phone. After a few iterations, I ended up up-selling myself from 6.6kw to 10kw for not much extra $ (mostly by upgrading from a 370w to a similarly sized-and-priced 415w panel, then chucking a few more on as well).When the panels landed, Winki were able to get a better price for me, without my asking, and reduced my quote accordingly.Installation took a while to get started, which was understandable given the surge in solar enquiries and terrible weather. When they actually started, the team was there every morning at 7am on the dot. I was given choices about cable runs and they were happy to do slightly more difficult but better-looking runs for me. A few broken tiles along the way were to be expected, but all were replaced and everything tidied up perfectly at the end.

Right from the beginning Winki were so helpful, friendly, prompt and professional.Everything occurred in a punctual manner, and I was constantly kept in the loop for every stage. Nothing was too much trouble  and I was so impressed that there was very little I had to do. Everything was taken care of, on my behalf. I would highly recommend Winki as a solar panel installer.
Great team and clever installers negotiating through the mire of tape between the various power companies.Tidy and punctual and kept me informed of the progress right through to energisation

After having dealt with too many tradesmen recently on our new build Dex and the team at Winki were a breath of fresh air. Their quote wasn't the cheapest but I decided to go with them because of the patience, level of communication and respect they showed me as a customer. Dex was always there to answer my litany of questions (I'm not an easy customer! I need to know everything!) and was always responsive and detailed. When it came to installation I was relieved I didn't have to ask for proper safety provisions (they automatically quoted a scissor lift). Alex and the team did an amazing job and there wasn't a single bit of garbage left or anything untidy. Often you get what you pay for and I'm so glad I invested the time and money in Winki. Our system is already performing so well and the cabling is barely visible. Thank you, this was a huge decision for us (and a big financial investment) and it went very smoothly and we are very happy. Cannot recommend enough.
Dex was a pleasure to work with. Great communication, quoting and execution. Stoked with the result.

The Salespeople I dealt with were very attentive and quick to respond.They took into consideration our preference not to have the panels visible from the road.Installation was very prompt after signing and went ahead without issue.

The Saleperson I dealt with was very attentive and quick to respond.Installation went ahead without issue. Punctual, polite etc.Panels were installed two weeks ago - currently still awaiting an inspector to check the system before proceeding with connection to grid (so can’t comment yet on my level of satisfaction for that part of the process.
Thorough service in a friendly manner. Prompt replies to all my questions.

Very happy with our new solar system. The guys at winki were really accommodating initially, answering questions and rearranging quotes and designs. The installation process was quick and they kept us updated with any changes. Would use these guys again for sure.

From the start, Winki were the first of the three companies to quote, not only did they provide a quote for the system I requested but also for a lower & higher KWH producing system so I could compare all the data. Dexter was my contact & from day one we had an instant connection he was polite & courteous at all times keeping me fully informed with phonecalls & follow up emails even on weekends & public holidays, Winki are very lucky to have such an asset.Installers arrived less than a week after paying the deposit, they were on time & despite being a less than straight forward install, I have multi split roof, Alex from Sulec & his team handled it in their stride. Despite being a man down on the day they finished the job in one day & cleaned up after themselves. Alex even set up the Goodwe app on my mobile phone. In less than 48hrs ESV inspector was on site & commissioned my new system which is going gangbusters.The original price quoted was a little over my budget as I was not entitled to any rebates so I advised Dexter that I would need to go to another cheaper quote but I wasn't comfortable in doing so. Dexter came back with a proposal that fitted my budget & although still more expensive than the cheaper quote I felt more comfortable dealing with Winki.I could not have asked for a more smoother install, Dexter, Alex & the gang are to be congratulated for his efforts.

Winki Solutions is a small business that will build a good reputation and is willing to tackle a tricky installation. They have installed a system of about 19 and a half Kw on a metal roof with 35 degree pitch. About 7 Kw on the east surface and about 12Kw on the west face. It contains 53 370w Trina panels on 5 strings which run 13 metres under the pergola to the rear of my garage and into a 15 Kw Fronius 3 phase inverter. The AC runs from the inverter 6 meters through the roof to a sub-board. There is a smart meter installed at the mains board (which is a further 10 meters from the sub board) to feed data to the inverter so that the system can balance the output and won't exceed the maximum allowed on each phase. Installation was only completed less than a week ago and at this stage I am waiting for the final inspection which is booked for 3 days time before the system can be activated.

From start to finish our experience with Dex and Winki Solar was first class. They went over and above to ensure our solar experience was painless.Dex explained everything really well and was always available to chat about the quote and the different solar system options before we committed to buying.The install team led by Alex were excellent. The communication beforehand was great and they showed up on time. They talked us through the job before starting and made sure the layout was what we wanted. They clearly take pride in their work and everything was neat and tidy.Communication since the install has been brilliant and Dex has made sure everything is working as it should.
We were delighted to find excellent local installers for our solar.

The sales and quoting service was informative,knowledgeable and presented in layman's language, so it was easy to understand the pricing structure and the whole installation process.The installation went as planned, with the team arriving punctually onsite, and individually introducing themselves. They explained what they were doing and apologised in advance for any noises they made while walking across our flat roof, and drilling the stays that secured the solar panels. The site was left exactly as they found it with all packaging taken away.Customer Service and follow through at every step of the way was excellent, from the explanations of the process,assistance with the rebate system, the installation set up,monitoring, the inspection certification and the grid connection after the installation.After some fairly heavy winds over Christmas, two of the team came to inspect the installation to ensure everything was as it should be.

I was really impressed with how hard Winki worked to make this a successful installation. All their communications were clear, helpful and timely. They were very proactive and responsive with the different design options, and they installed the system for us in a very short timeframe to ensure we were eligible for the higher rebate before the end of year reduction.They took real pride in their work and the installation was undertaken to a very high standard (I had some particular requirements which they more than satisfied). They closely monitored performance for some weeks after the installation to ensure that everything was working well. I have had solar panels installed twice before, and overall I would rate the service provided by WInki as outstanding.

Supplier spent a lot of time talking through options and explaining the technology to me. They were happy to answer my millions of questions, and very responsive via email and phone calls.The price given was very fair (I got 7 quotes) for the system we wanted, and they installed it within 1 week of the paperwork being signed!

Our experience with Winki Solar and Dexter their sales consultant was excellent. Dexter was responsive and very helpful especially taking care to do a thorough onsite inspection to access the impact of the shade trees. His attention to detail and follow up was great and assistance navigating the difficulties of Vic Solar much appreciated.The installation was incident free, the team were very polite and completed the job efficiently. Very punctual and tidy.

Steve and the crew from Winki Solar were very professional, explained what system would be best for our needs and suitable to fit on our house. We are very impressed with the workmanship and the final product. The fact that this is a local company on the Surf Coast gives us the peace of mind should we ever need anything fixed.

Steve was very easy to deal with and installation was neat tidy and punctual. Just waiting on inspector as it has been over 2 weeks and still a no show. Steve has called inspector but i think the inspector is quite disorganised and still wont show up to commission the install. If this is government i am not surprised.

I choose to procure my Solar System from Winki Solutions after shopping for a number of quotes, but wanted a local installer with a record of quality installation. Based upon a recommendation from an electrician who had seen their work, I chose Winki, and they provided a high quality system at a competitive price.The communication from Steve throughout the process was excellent and they arrived and installed the system on time.The quality of work was also to a high standard, with a slightly difficult installation to run the DC cable to the inverter in my garage. The work was neat and tidy and no damage to my house occured.I would recommend Winki Solutions to others considering a solar system.
